extDescription.message: Shows, on your own computer, which third parties the page you are viewing contacts. Counts, not verdicts. Sends nothing.

headline.message: tracking services contacted before your first click

stoppedBrowser.message: blocked by your browser's tracking protection: $1

noInteraction.message: You have not clicked or typed on this page yet.

baselineText.message: $1 tracking services on $2, from $3 (a clean browser with no history).

baselineDiff.message: Seen here but not in the weekly list: $1. In the weekly list but not here: $2.

notMeasured.message: This site is not in our weekly measurement.

why.message: Your number can differ: your browser, country, earlier consent, history and live ad auctions all change what a page loads.

honesty.message: We see that a request happened, not what was sent or what the company does with it. The list is limited: this is not complete protection.

noData.message: No data for this tab yet. Reload the page to measure it.

truncated.message: This page made too many requests: the report stops at a limit.

toldTitle.message: What your browser told this site

toldNoSelf.message: Reload the page to see what your browser sent with it.

toldCookies.message: Third-party requests that carried your cookies

toldReferer.message: Third-party requests that carried this page's address

toldNote.message: Every server contacted also sees your IP address, which the browser cannot show. These details stay in this browser's memory for this tab and are never sent anywhere; cookie and parameter values are never kept.
